topic: Ruby Gold: an elegant woman in a red dress makes a pomegranate pineapple drink in a luxury lounge
style: Photorealistic macro beverage commercial shot on a 100mm lens, locked-off tripod camera, dark upscale lounge bar, warm bokeh, real glass, real fresh fruit, natural colors, tactile sound, no labels.
requestedEnding: The layered red and gold drink is lifted and sipped, glowing in sharp focus.

storyArc.protagonist: an elegant dark-haired woman in a fitted red evening dress, making a drink at a marble bar
storyArc.setting: glamorous upscale lounge at night with warm golden bokeh lights and a dark marble bar
storyArc.goal: Build a jewel-toned fresh drink from two fruits with graceful, confident movements.
storyArc.obstacle: The pomegranate base hides its final color until the golden pour.
storyArc.turn: Fresh pineapple juice flows over the ruby base and makes a glowing two-tone layer.
storyArc.visualBible: Food is the focus of every shot. Same straight-sided tall clear glass on the same dark marble bar in the same dim lounge with warm golden bokeh. Macro shots show only an elegant hand with deep red nails. In the final shot the drink is sharp in the foreground and the woman in the red dress is only a soft blurred figure behind it. Locked camera, natural colors, real liquid physics. No labels, logos or text.

beats.label: The layered drink is lifted and sipped

shots.imagePrompt: Macro photograph of a tall straight-sided clear highball glass filled with fresh ruby pomegranate arils on a dark marble bar, dim upscale lounge with soft warm bokeh behind. An elegant hand with deep red nails holds a slim steel muddler just above the arils. Natural juicy fruit texture, sharp glass edges and reflections, shot on a 100mm macro lens, locked camera, no labels, no text.
shots.motionPrompt: The hand presses the steel muddler down into the pomegranate arils twice with a crushing motion, so deep red juice rises in the glass. The camera stays locked and steady. One continuous physical action, no cuts.
shots.sound: glass tap, juicy fruit crush, soft lounge ambience

shots.imagePrompt: Macro photograph of a tall clear glass of crushed ruby pomegranate juice on a dark marble bar, dim upscale lounge with warm bokeh behind. Photorealistic, shot on a 100mm macro lens, locked camera, natural colors, no labels, no text.
shots.motionPrompt: A thin continuous stream of pale golden pineapple juice pours from the small glass jug into the glass, a tiny splash crown forms where it lands, micro-bubbles rise, and the gold juice settles into a glowing layer over the ruby juice.
